title: LibWeb/CSS: Stop stripping out whitespace tokens before parsing property values
task_prompt: Fix the failing test Tests/LibWeb/Text/input/wpt-import/css/css-overflow/parsing/scrollbar-gutter-valid.html and the CSS Typed OM tests under Tests/LibWeb/Text/input/wpt-import/css/css-typed-om/. Whitespace tokens are being stripped from CSS property values before parsing, which breaks cases where whitespace is meaningful — for example, custom property values that contain whitespace, or Typed OM serialization that requires whitespace to round-trip correctly. The expected outputs are the corresponding .txt files in Tests/LibWeb/Text/expected/.
